Principle 11 : My Single Life
(Graduated from university)
My University life was a good time.
During that time I was thinking about my future.
I joined many clubs, made a lot of friends and I made preparations to get a job.
Because it is difficult to get a good job I had to prepare very hard.
(My First Job)
As soon as I graduated from University I got a job at a small trade company.
The working conditions were not good but I was happy to be independent.
Sometimes I was very stressed out by my boss and all of my responsibilities but I really enjoyed the teamwork in my job.
I am a very optimistic person and was able to overcome this time in my life.
(Dating)
When I was working in that company my friend introduced me to a man.
When we met the first time I was not interested in him.
We continued to date and I.
I liked him more.
Over time I got to know him better and better.
My boyfriend was not nice looking but he treated me very well and I liked that.
We dated over five years.
